facts.claim: Belle 躲在卧室里，Abi 敲门问她在不在，她关掉手机不应答。
Belle 等了十分钟后收拾东西溜出宅子，一路走到门口岗亭叫 Uber。
facts.quote: I began the long walk from the front of the house to the security shack

facts.claim: 在 Luke 床上事后，Belle 发现他发根颜色更浅，问他为什么染发。
facts.quote: “Why do you dye your hair?” I asked. “I don’t see any gray in it.”

facts.claim: Belle 由 Dan 的滑翔翼联想到三角锣，推断 Deirdre 是从庄园后方滑翔进来的。
facts.quote: she’d be entering from the back of the property and no one would see her

facts.claim: Belle 想在打给 Kay 前先取出手机，却发现手机从皮包里不见了。
facts.quote: My phone was gone. But how could that be?

facts.claim: Belle 对 Luke 说出“斯坦福监狱实验”，挑明他就是 Austin Gregory。
Belle 问 Eli Pratt 替他在牢里待了多久，Luke 回答“十四年”。
facts.quote: How many years has Eli Pratt been rotting away in your jail cell?

facts.claim: Belle 用两天前在机场买的钢笔刺进他颈根的小三角，命中他的 sweet spot。
facts.quote: I hit him in his sweet spot.

relations.rel: 同住 Sweet Spot 的伙伴，敲门找她
relations.quote: It was Abi. I froze on the bed—but not before turning off my phone.

relations.rel: 她躲着不想见的前男友／旧识
relations.quote: Oh hell no. I couldn’t face him right now—couldn’t face them.

relations.rel: 性关系对象，她以为的“快乐之地”
relations.quote: The brawny arms of Luke Fulton made me feel a little less lost and lonely.

relations.rel: Swole Squad 的教练与学员，问滑翔翼存放处
relations.quote: “Hey, where does Dan Caraway store the hang gliders he uses for his Squad?”

relations.rel: 替身： Eli 冒名 Luke Fulton 顶替 Austin 坐牢
relations.quote: Eli Pratt had begun working at Dead Horse under the assumed name of Luke Fulton

relations.rel: 决裂后仍要通报案情的警探
relations.quote: It was time to call Kay, and I wanted all my faculties about me

numbers.claim: 她等 Abi 与 Denny 离开约十分钟才出门
numbers.quote: I waited for about ten minutes after they left

numbers.claim: 她两天前才在 Zoom 上第一次见到 Luke
numbers.quote: how was it possible that had been just two days ago?

numbers.claim: 过去二十四小时里她与 Luke 多次上床
numbers.quote: as many times as I had in the past twenty-four hours

numbers.claim: Eli Pratt 顶替他坐牢的年数
Deirdre 在狱中服刑二十年，刚获释
第一块牛排下锅还不到两分钟就要翻面
numbers.quote: It couldn’t have been cooking for more than two minutes.

numbers.claim: Austin 自称被 Samuel 侵犯时十八岁
Luke／Austin 的实际年龄四十岁
她整段推理只在半秒内闪过脑海
numbers.quote: had flashed through my mind in about half a second

numbers.claim: 他举刀朝她逼近了一步
numbers.quote: taken one angry step in my direction

numbers.claim: 他用两齿长叉戳起牛排
numbers.quote: the two long, elegant prongs of a wooden-handled carving fork

numbers.claim: “斯坦福监狱实验”四个字改变了一切
numbers.quote: Those four little words changed everything.

turning_point: Belle 在 Luke 的厨房里说出“斯坦福监狱实验”，当面揭穿 Luke Fulton 就是 Austin Gregory——她要对付的凶手一直就在身边。
notes: 叙事顺序有一处跳跃：Belle 走到岗亭叫车之后，直接切到“已在 Luke 家床上”，Uber 行程以回忆补叙（第 55 行）。hang glider／绳子／钥匙等手法均为 Belle 的推断，Luke 多以点头或不答默认，非全部明说。
